segments.text: Marco had one rule on the museum night shift: never look away from the cameras.
At midnight, every statue was exactly where it should be.
At one, the stone knight in Hall Three was facing the door.
Marco laughed it off. Probably the cleaners.
At two, the knight was in the hallway. And the cleaners had gone home hours ago.
He grabbed his flashlight and walked to Hall Three, heart pounding.
The knight was back on its pedestal. Perfectly still.
But on the dusty floor were fresh footprints, leading straight to the security office.
Marco checked the cameras one last time. His own chair was empty, and something was sitting in it.
